description.en: The time in big, bold numbers under today's date, like the iPhone Lock Screen. Larger sizes add other cities, how far ahead or behind they are and whether it is already tomorrow there. Pick 12 or 24 hours, your cities, the font, weight and color, or an analog face. Works as soon as you add it.

hourCycle.title: Clock
hourCycle.description: 12 or 24 hours. Automatic follows your language and region.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Time zones by name, separated by commas, for example Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo. Leave empty for Los Angeles, New York, London, Tokyo and Sydney (skipping the ones at your own time).

face.title: Face
face.description: Digital numbers, or an analog dial (small and medium).

font.title: Font
font.description: The time's typeface: rounded like the Lock Screen, the system font, serif, monospaced or condensed.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: How heavy the time's numbers are, from thin to heavy.

color.title: Color
color.description: The time's color: text (your theme's), accent, muted, glass (translucent), or a color like #FF9500.

date.title: Date
date.description: Show the date over the time.
